## Rationale

Still dogfood: rename every shipped surface in one phase—plugin manifests and marketplace, Python package `se_workflow` → `affidavit`, CLI `bin/aff` (drop `bin/se-workflow`), skills/docs/AGENTS, contract `"project": "affidavit"` plus ensure-store foreign-contract gate, this repo’s live design copy, tests, sync paths, and the GitHub repository `andrewy1n/se-workflow` → `andrewy1n/affidavit`. No long-lived `se-workflow` aliases.

## Counter-argument

Product-only rename (leave contract project id and/or GitHub name) would shrink the diff and avoid remote rename risk. That leaves permanent dual names, which the user explicitly rejected by asking for everything including the repo rename.
